subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Distinguir diferentes propostas editoriais – sensacionalismo, jornalismo investigativo etc. –, de forma a identificar os recursos utilizados para impactar/chocar o leitor que podem comprometer uma análise crítica da notícia e do fato noticiado.

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre abordagens jornalísticas sensacionalistas e investigativas em textos noticiosos
components.description_en: Distinguish between sensationalist and investigative journalistic approaches in news texts
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between facts and opinions to evaluate source credibility

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos usados em noticiários para impactar ou chocar o leitor
components.description_en: Identify devices used in news reports to impact or shock the reader
components.cc_component_description: Identify words and phrases in a text that create a specific effect on the reader

components.description_pt: Analisar como recursos sensacionalistas podem comprometer leitura crítica de evento noticioso
components.description_en: Analyze how sensationalist devices may compromise a critical reading of a news event
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an author's point of view shapes their account of an event or topic

components.description_pt: Avaliar abordagem editorial de texto jornalístico para desenvolver postura crítica
components.description_en: Evaluate the editorial approach of a journalistic text to develop a critical stance
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the relevance and quality of evidence chosen to develop a specific topic

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret social studies arguments by
* Identifying topic and __purpose (argue in favor or against a position, present a balanced interpretation, challenge perspective)__
* Analyzing __relevant information from one or two sources to develop claims in response to compelling questions__
* Evaluating source __credibility__ based on distinctions between fact and opinion
Analyze multiple accounts of the same event or topic, noting important similarities and differences in the point of view they represent.
Develop the topic with relevant, well-chosen facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples.
Choose words and phrases for effect.
